lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgTaO₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 24 atoms (Mg₄Ta₄O₁₆) distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Mg and Ta centers each coordinated by eight O neighbors, while O centers show five- or six-coordinate environments. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reports corner- and edge-sharing between Mg and Ta eight-vertex polyhedra, and between O-centered five- and six-vertex polyhedra.
